decision: Can we afford to spend more on acquisition, and what CAC can we not exceed?
limitations: Uses gross-margin LTV, so it reads lower than a revenue LTV; compare it only with other gross-margin figures.
LTV is only as good as the churn estimate, and early-stage churn estimates tend to be optimistic. Run a range, not one number.
Blended CAC (all new customers over all sales and marketing spend) flatters paid channels. Use paid CAC for channel decisions and say which one you used.
A healthy LTV:CAC with a long payback can still strain a cash-tight business; the ratio is not a cash plan.
review: The founder or finance lead confirms the churn and CAC inputs, and which CAC was used, before the result sets a budget or a CAC ceiling. Run the optimistic and the conservative churn case.
